sloka: कथम् प्रकृति सम्पन्ना राज पुत्री तथा अगुणा ।ब्रूयात् सा प्राकृता इव स्त्री मत् पीडाम् भर्तृ सम्निधौ ॥२-२२-१९॥
transliteration: katham prakṛti sampannā rāja putrī tathā aguṇā ।brūyāt sā prākṛtā iva strī mat pīḍām bhartṛ samnidhau ॥2-22-19॥

translations.english: If destiny is not the cause behind this, how could Kaikeyi who is gifted with virtues and a noble nature speak such painful words to me before her husband, like an ordinary woman?
